name: Chickpea Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp paprika and 1 tsp soy sauce
Topping: 200 g cauliflower and 100 g potato, boiled and mashed with 2 tbsp unsweetened soy milk
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, spices and tomato paste.
Add the chickpeas, peas, stock and soy sauce and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Mash the cauliflower and potato with the soy milk, salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling into a baking dish and cover with the mash.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden on top.
note: Replacing most of the potato with cauliflower keeps the carbohydrate down.
